# Local motion dependencies

Copied from the published npm package archives; original minified copyright headers are retained.

- GSAP **3.15.0**, including ScrollTrigger and SplitText: https://registry.npmjs.org/gsap/-/gsap-3.15.0.tgz
  - Homepage and documentation: https://gsap.com/
  - License referenced in the package header: https://gsap.com/standard-license
- Lenis **1.3.27**: https://registry.npmjs.org/lenis/-/lenis-1.3.27.tgz
  - Project and integration documentation: https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis
  - Included package license: LENIS-LICENSE.txt

No animation dependency requires a third-party CDN request at runtime.
